name: SUPIMA Percale
description: Woven from SUPIMA cotton — representing less than 1% of the world's cotton supply. Its extra-long fibres produce a percale with exceptional strength and a cool, clean hand-feel that improves with every wash.
description_zh: 採用全球不到1%的SUPIMA棉紡製而成，超長纖維打造出高強度平織床單，觸感清爽潔淨，每次洗滌後更加柔順舒適。

name: Egyptian Cotton Sateen
description: Long-staple Egyptian cotton in a four-over-one satin weave creates a luminous, silky surface with a subtle sheen. Drapes beautifully, resists wrinkles, and feels indulgent from the first night.
description_zh: 長絨埃及棉以四上一下緞紋織法織成，呈現光澤絲滑的表面。垂墜感佳、抗皺性強，從第一個夜晚起就帶來奢華享受。

name: Topcell™ Lyocell
description: Tonia Nicole's signature Topcell™ uses pine-pulp Lyocell with Faser-Lock™ British technology — enhanced fibre bonding that triples durability versus standard Lyocell. Feather-soft, hypoallergenic, and remarkably cool.
description_zh: 東妮寢飾獨家Topcell™採用松木漿天絲，結合英國Faser-Lock™技術，纖維結合強度是標準天絲的三倍。超柔、低敏、清涼感卓越。

name: TN Tencel 80S
description: OEKO-TEX certified Tencel Lyocell in an 80S yarn count. Silky smooth, hypoallergenic, and closed-loop manufactured — absorbs moisture 50% faster than cotton while remaining completely breathable.
description_zh: OEKO-TEX認證天絲Lyocell 80支紗，絲滑觸感、低敏特性、閉環製程——吸濕速度比棉快50%，同時保持完全透氣。

name: European Linen
description: Stone-washed European flax linen — the most breathable natural fibre available. Inherently temperature-regulating and only gets softer, more supple, and more beautiful with every year of use.
description_zh: 石洗歐洲亞麻——最透氣的天然纖維。天然調溫特性讓您保持舒適，越洗越柔軟，越用越美麗。

name: Silk 22MM
description: 22-momme mulberry silk — Tonia Nicole's premium grade. Naturally hypoallergenic protein fibre that regulates temperature, reduces friction on hair and skin, and is recommended by dermatologists for eczema-prone sleepers.
description_zh: 22姆米桑蠶絲——東妮寢飾頂級規格。天然低敏蛋白纖維，調節體溫、減少對髮膚的摩擦，皮膚科醫師推薦給濕疹肌膚者使用。

name: Brushed Flannel Cotton
description: Double-brushed cotton flannel for exceptional warmth and cloud-like softness. Ideal for cold bedrooms and winter nights — wrap yourself in the feeling of a warm embrace.
description_zh: 雙面刷毛棉法蘭絨，提供卓越保暖性與如雲朵般的柔軟感。適合寒冷臥室與冬夜——如同溫暖擁抱般的睡眠體驗。

name: CoolTouch Nylon Fiber
description: Tonia Nicole's high-performance nylon fibre delivers an instant cooling sensation on contact, wicks moisture rapidly, and dries in a fraction of the time of cotton — perfect for hot sleepers who prioritise low-maintenance care.
description_zh: 東妮寢飾高性能尼龍纖維，接觸瞬間帶來清涼感，快速吸濕導汗，乾燥速度遠快於棉——適合重視低保養的熱睡者。
